features: TOUCHES THE DATABASE: A NEW TABLE FOR RECEIPTS, NO DATA REWRITTEN — A new migration, which the update runs by itself, creates the table registro_invii, where the program writes every receipt that is printed or sent by email: the person, the channel, the address, the choices of that issue (the stamp duty, the note, the payment description, the content of the receipt), the fingerprint of the PDF, the status and who issued it. It changes no table that was there and rewrites no data: right after the update no figure changes, and all the payments recorded before show as «mai emessa» (never issued). The table, each of its two indexes and each of its four foreign keys have their own check: a run interrupted halfway resumes from where it had got to, and where it has already run it does nothing. No new permission (receipts sit where payments sit, and whoever already has access to payments sees and issues them), no new library, the requirements do not change. Three things to know after the update. (a) The «Ricevute» (receipts) page opens on the receipts never issued for payments from the first day of last month: after the update all earlier payments show as having no receipt, and this way the page does not offer you a year of receipts to send. For older payments you widen the period in the filters; the preview of a print or a send warns you if the ones you chose include payments older than 60 days. (b) Sending by email works only if a server is configured in the mail settings: without one, sending is refused before anything is written and says what to do, and the receipt can be printed, downloaded or prepared to send from your own mail program. (c) If the installation sends emails without a queue (the queue is set to «sync»), the messages go out inside the request and a bulk send sends at most 50 at a time, to whole people (one person alone goes out whole even if they have more): the page tells you who is left. With the queue set to «database» the emails go out from the service that sends them, and if that service is not running they stay «in coda» (queued). After the update, reload the pages that are already open.

CHANGES: THE «STAMPA RICEVUTA» ITEM IN EVERY PAYMENT'S MENU DOES WHAT IT SAYS — In the menu of every payment the item «Stampa Ricevuta» (Print receipt) opened a notice, «Funzionalità stampa ricevuta in arrivo!» (receipt printing coming soon). Now the item is called «Stampa o invia ricevuta» (Print or send receipt) and opens the window «Ricevuta di pagamento» (payment receipt), where you choose the stamp duty, write a note, choose who it goes to and then press «Anteprima» (Preview), «Stampa» (Print) or «Invia» (Send): you can print and send without reopening it. For a cancelled payment the item says «Stampa o invia ricevuta (annullato)» (Print or send receipt (cancelled)). Above the list of payments there is a «Ricevute» (Receipts) button that leads to the receipts page; next to it, it says how many are missing («3 senza ricevuta dal 01/10/2026», 3 without a receipt since 01/10/2026), counted over the same period with which the page opens, from the first day of last month.

CHANGES: THE EMAIL LOG AND THE MAIL GUIDE TELL THE TRUTH — In the email log («Audit & Logs», «Email Logs») a message that the program only recorded, because there is no mail server, now has the words «Non partita» (not sent) under the icon and, when you hover over it, the explanation; before, it had only the blue icon. The mail guide no longer promises «il 100% di tracciabilità» (100% traceability) and says what the program does: it records every message the server accepts, and without a server it marks it as not sent; «accepted» does not mean «delivered». The description of «Posta in Uscita» (outgoing mail) in the settings no longer mentions payment reminders, which the program does not send.

CHANGES: THE REVERSAL CONFIRMATION SAYS WHETHER THE RECEIPT HAS ALREADY GONE OUT — If the receipt of a payment has already been printed or sent, the confirmation for reversing it («storno») says so: «La ricevuta di questo incasso è stata inviata a … il …» (the receipt of this payment was sent to … on …) or «… è stata stampata il …» (… was printed on …). It also says that after the reversal the receipt can be printed again or, if it had gone by email, sent again, and that it comes out with «INCASSO ANNULLATO» (PAYMENT CANCELLED); whether and how to tell the person is up to you. The reversal works as before: the receipt does not block it.

NEW: THE RECEIPT OF A PAYMENT, WITH THE STAMP DUTY, THE ORIGINAL AND THE COPY — The payment receipt («Ricevuta di pagamento») gives the number (the payment's protocol number), the date of the payment and the date of issue; who paid and on whose behalf, when they are two different people; the amount and the cash account it went into; then, in a table, the instalments the payment goes to: for each one the unit, the instalment, the due date, the amount of the instalment, what had been paid before this payment, how much is allocated and how much is left. If part of it is covered by a person's credit it says so («di cui dal credito», of which from credit), and if there is an excess it says who it is credited to or which instalment it reduces. The «already paid before» follows the order in which the program recorded the payments, the same order in which it allocated the money. The note is yours to write. The payment's description («causale») is printed only if you tick «Stampa la causale» (Print the description), because it is free text and may carry internal notes. The receipt has the header and signature of the condominium's other printouts. The stamp duty: for every receipt you choose the status of the stamp duty, «Assolta» (paid), «Non dovuta» (not due) or «Da assolvere» (still to be paid), and without the choice the receipt does not come out; above € 77.47 and up to € 77.47 are chosen separately. Above € 77.47 the window only writes «Importo sopra € 77,47» (amount above € 77.47). Whether and how the receipt bears the stamp duty is for you to decide, with your accountant. With «Assolta» you say how: by revenue stamp («contrassegno») or in virtual mode («modo virtuale»), and you may write the details (the stamp number, or the authorisation): the PDF reads «Assolta — contrassegno n. …» or «Assolta in modo virtuale — …». Original and copy: the first receipt issued for a payment is the original; every issue after that comes out with «COPIA» (COPY) at the top and the date of the original, with the figures of the original even if something has changed in the meantime (if it has, the window says so and points to the person's account statement). Before the first issue the window says that it will be the original. «Anteprima» opens the same PDF with «ANTEPRIMA — non è una ricevuta» (PREVIEW — not a receipt) at the top and «Non emessa» (not issued) in place of the date: it writes nothing and does not turn the real receipt into a «Copia».

NEW: THE «RICEVUTE» PAGE, WITH FILTERS AND THE CHOICE OF PEOPLE — The «Ricevute degli incassi» (payment receipts) page is made for the work you do every month. It opens on the receipts «Mai emessa» (never issued) for payments from the first day of last month to today (the period is visible and can be changed), one row per payment: number and date, the person (and who paid), the amount, whether they have an email, and the last issue («stampata il …», printed on …; «inviata il … a …», sent on … to …; «in coda», queued; «non partita», not sent, with the reason and the stamp duty status chosen). The filters are: receipt (never issued, already printed, already sent or queued, all), period of the payment, management, cash account, email (with or without), amount (above € 77.47 or up to € 77.47) and people, one, some or all (empty: all), with a search by name. Next to each person, «solo questa persona» (only this person) sets the filter on the person and leaves the others as they are: for the receipts they have already had, set «Ricevuta» (receipt) to «Tutte» (all) and widen the period. It is the case of the owner who phones and asks for their receipts. You choose one row at a time, the whole page, or «tutte le N dei filtri» (all N matching the filters). The list does not include cancelled payments, payments into which no money came (instalments covered by credit alone: there is no payment to receive) and payments that cover the instalments of several people without saying who paid: the payment's window explains it and points to each person's account statement. If among the never-issued receipts there are payments older than the period but recorded recently, the page says so and «Includile» (Include them) moves the period back to the oldest payment.

NEW: PRINTING RECEIPTS IN BULK, FOR THE POST OR ONE PDF PER PERSON — From the receipts page, «Stampa le selezionate» (Print the selected) makes a single PDF, with each receipt starting on a new page. The receipts of the same person stay together, with the person's address at the top right of the first, as in a letter (the condominium on the left, the title right below): one envelope per person. The order can be chosen: by person, by unit or by payment date. People without a postal address appear by name in the preview, before printing. A PDF holds at most 200 receipts: beyond that, the preview splits the people into parts, each kept whole (a person with more than 200 receipts is split), and offers «Stampa le prime N», «Stampa le altre N» and «Stampa l'ultima» (Print the first N, the other N, the last); after the first part the order cannot be changed. «Scarica un PDF per persona» (Download one PDF per person) gives a .zip archive with one PDF per person (their chosen receipts, with their name as the file name) and the file «Indirizzi email.txt» with the addresses of each: it is for those who send the receipts from their own mail program; the PDF has no address of the person; here too at most 200 receipts. Every receipt printed or downloaded this way is an issue, with the choices you made: the stamp duty status (above and up to € 77.47 separately), how it was paid, the note and «Stampa la causale».

NEW: SENDING RECEIPTS BY EMAIL, ONE OR MANY — Sending starts from a payment's window («Invia») or from the receipts page («Invia per email le selezionate», Send the selected by email). Where a choice repeats, the program remembers the last one you made in that condominium: the stamp duty status (after «Assolta» with a revenue stamp, which belongs to one sheet only, it proposes nothing), the way and the details if you paid it in virtual mode, «Stampa la causale», the addresses of the bulk send; the first time the stamp duty is not chosen, the description is not printed and in bulk the primary and the secondary address are ticked. The note is never remembered: it is valid for the receipt you write it on, and in bulk for the selected ones only if you write it in that window. Who it goes to: the person of the position, with the primary and the secondary address already ticked, if they have them. Not the PEC (certified email): the program sends it as an ordinary email from the configured server, not as a PEC, and some PEC mailboxes refuse messages that do not come from a PEC; the window says so. Not the person who paid for someone else, because the receipt carries the position's instalments and you tick whether it should go to them too. When sending a single receipt you can write another address, if the person asks for it to be sent elsewhere: sends to hand-written addresses are at most ten per minute per user. A person with no address cannot be ticked: «Nessun indirizzo email: stampala per la posta» (No email address: print it for the post). In bulk the program sends one message per address, with a PDF that carries all the chosen receipts of that person (at most 50 per message: above that, the person receives more messages). Before sending, the preview says how many people, how many receipts and to how many addresses; for each person the addresses, the receipt numbers and the messages, and you can remove a person; it counts those already sent or queued and proposes to exclude them (ticked); it warns about payments older than 60 days, about how many have a description and about who has no address among those chosen, to print for the post. When the send is done, the summary says, with only the items that apply, «Partite N, in coda M, non partite P, senza indirizzo K» (sent N, queued M, not sent P, without address K), with the button «Stampa le K senza indirizzo» (Print the K without address). «Mandane una a me» (Send one to me) immediately sends, to the address of whoever is working, the message of the first remaining person, with its PDF carrying «PROVA — non è una ricevuta» (TEST — not a receipt) at the top; it writes nothing among the receipt's issues and does not turn the real receipts into «Copia» (the message is in the email log, like every message, with the subject «Prova — …»). The subject is «Condominio … — Ricevuta n. … del …» (with several receipts, «Condominio … — Ricevute di pagamento (N)»); the text gives the amount, the date and the number; the rest is in the attached PDF. The sender is the one in the mail settings.

NEW: AFTER SENDING, THE ISSUES, «INVIA DI NUOVO» AND «RIPROVA LE NON PARTITE» — Every time a receipt goes out, printed, downloaded, prepared for email or sent, the program writes a row in the register. A send starts «in coda» (queued) and becomes «inviata» (sent) when the mail server accepts the message (the email log has its row), or «non partita» (not sent) with the error. Everyone reads the server's error as a simple sentence with the code («Il server di posta non ha accettato il messaggio (codice 535)», the mail server did not accept the message (code 535)); the full text is seen only by whoever manages the general settings, like the email log. The payment's page has the «Ricevuta» tab, with the issues («stampata il …», «inviata il … a …», «in coda», «non partita» with the reason) and the stamp duty status chosen; «Invia di nuovo» (Send again) sends the receipt again (it asks for a confirmation that says who it goes to and with which stamp duty) and «Riprova le non partite» (Retry the ones not sent) sends the ones not sent again, also from the receipts page. They go to the address the person has today in the register of people, of the same type; a hand-written address stays as it was. A send that did not go out is not retried if after it the receipt came out in a PDF for the same person (printed, prepared for email, in the per-person archive): the person has had it, and it does not reach them twice. After an hour «in coda» the page says so: it usually means that the service that sends queued emails is not running on the server, and whoever manages the installation checks it.

NEW: THE RECEIPT OF A CANCELLED PAYMENT — The receipt of a cancelled payment can be printed: it comes out with «INCASSO ANNULLATO» (PAYMENT CANCELLED) at the top, the date and number of the reversal and the sentence that the instalments no longer count as paid with that payment. If the receipt had already gone out by email it can be sent again, only to the addresses it had gone to, as they were then (even if they have changed in the register of people) and without adding others; a receipt that was only printed, queued or not sent is not sent, it is printed. In the receipts page a notice lists the payments cancelled after the receipt went out: the person had it, then the payment was cancelled. If the receipt is printed again or sent again the notice goes away; «Non serve comunicarla» (No need to tell them) removes it without printing or sending anything (it asks for a confirmation; the choice stays among the payment's issues, with who and when, and cannot be undone). Whether and how to tell the person is up to you. The receipt of a payment cancelled while its message is queued does not go out: its row becomes «non partita» with the sentence «L'incasso è stato annullato prima dell'invio: la ricevuta non è partita» (the payment was cancelled before sending: the receipt did not go out); the other receipts of the same message, if there are any, go out.

NEW: «PREPARA L'EMAIL» FOR WHOEVER DOES NOT HAVE THE PROGRAM'S MAIL — Where the program has no mail server (no configuration, or mail that is only recorded), or when the last send of the receipt did not go out, the payment's window offers «Prepara l'email» (Prepare the email). It generates the PDF (it is an issue like printing, without the person's address at the top right) and, where the browser can share files, opens the system's share sheet with the PDF attached, the subject and the text: you choose the mail program and you write the address; otherwise it downloads the PDF and opens the email with the ticked recipients, the subject and the text, and whoever is working attaches the file: a mail link cannot attach a file in any browser. Afterwards, a box says that the receipt shows as printed and has «Apri l'email» (Open the email) and «Scarica di nuovo il PDF» (Download the PDF again). While the PDF is being prepared the window does not close and the address checkboxes stay still. In the receipts page «Scarica un PDF per persona» serves the same purpose.

HOW IT WORKS TODAY, WHERE IT MAKES A DIFFERENCE — (1) The receipt does not say how the payment was made (transfer, cash, cheque): the payment does not record it. Someone who paid for another person is named, but the receipt carries the position's instalments and not the balance of the instalments of whoever paid. (2) Whether and how the receipt bears the stamp duty is for you to decide, with your accountant: the program does not calculate it and does not pay it. The stamp duty is not charged anywhere, and whether to put it on the person or on the condominium is up to you. The number of a revenue stamp is valid for one receipt only; in bulk the window has no box for the number: the receipt reads «Assolta — contrassegno», and you write the number by hand on the sheet, or you issue each receipt from its own window. A receipt by email does not carry the stamp: how to pay the stamp duty, in virtual mode or with the revenue stamp on the copy that stays in the office, is up to you with your accountant. (3) «Sent» means that the mail server accepted the message, not that it was delivered. The PEC goes as an ordinary email, without delivery receipts. (4) The PDF of a receipt is not stored: it is generated again from the payment, which is not edited, it is reversed. The fingerprint of the issued PDF is in the register, but the same receipt generated again in another second has a different fingerprint, because the PDF carries the creation date: the fingerprint serves to compare the file the person holds with the one issued, not to regenerate it. A copy reproduces the figures, the names and the text of the description of the original (whether the description is printed is decided by «Stampa la causale» of that issue, or of the row you send again with «Invia di nuovo» and «Riprova»); the header and legal note of the condominium's printouts and the postal address are today's. (5) A payment into which no money came has no payment receipt, and neither has a payment that covers the instalments of several people without «Versato da» (Paid by): for these the payment's page points to the person's account statement. When one person's credit covers another's instalments, with no new money (a set-off), the receipt does not count it as credit used, the window says «è una compensazione, non un versamento» (it is a set-off, not a payment), and the person the credit belongs to receives no document. (6) If the installation sends emails without a queue (queue «sync»), the messages go out inside the request while the page waits: at most 50 at a time (one person alone goes out whole even if they have more), and the cap counts messages, not time; 50 messages to a slow server can still exceed the server's maximum time, and if that happens the rows already written stay «non partita», and «Riprova le non partite» picks them up, or «in coda» (queued): those «Riprova» does not pick up, and the bulk send with «Escludi le già inviate o in coda» (exclude those already sent or queued, ticked to start with) skips them; you send them again with «Invia di nuovo» from the row, or by unticking the box. With the «sync» queue, the notice «in coda for more than an hour» names the queue service, which is not there: a row like that is an interrupted send. The .zip of many people also takes time and, on a slow shared hosting, can exceed the server's maximum time. (7) A PDF (print, «Prepara l'email», .zip) switches off the «to retry» notice of the sends that did not go out before it, only for the person in the PDF, that is, the position, including the send to a hand-written address, which the register ties to the position: if the person had asked for the receipt at another address and the send did not go out, after a PDF «Riprova le non partite» does not send it again; use «Invia di nuovo» from its row. The send that did not go out for someone who paid for another person stays, and «Riprova le non partite» sends it again even if in «Prepara l'email» you had also ticked them; the person may receive it twice, the second time as a copy. (8) During «Prepara l'email» the window does not close until the server answers, and there is no maximum time: if the server never answers, reload the page; by then the receipt may already have gone out. (9) To look at a receipt without issuing it there is «Anteprima»: «Stampa» is an issue, and from then on the others come out as «Copia». A send still in the queue has not gone out: if you print in the meantime, the print is the original, and the send, when it goes, carries the date on which you queued it and does not say «COPIA»: both sheets say they are the original. (10) File sharing depends on the browser and the system: where it is missing, and without a default mail program, «Prepara l'email» leaves the PDF downloaded. (11) The name of the instalment and that of the cash account come from the data: a cash account called «Conto corrente» is written «Conto corrente (Conto corrente)», and a plan renamed after generation leaves the old name in its instalments. (12) The owner does not find the receipts in their account statement: they receive them by email or by post.
